assertion: The poverty rate in Camden fell to 24.9% in 2025, the lowest it has been since at least 2010.
reason: 2025 city table not readable: data.census.gov returned an empty page, the Census API needs a key, QuickFacts returned 403. ACS 2024 1-year city rate was 33.9%, so the implied one-year drop is 9 points against a margin of error near 5.6 points.
searched: Camden city New Jersey poverty rate ACS 1-year 2024 2023 2022 percent

assertion: In comparison, the poverty rate across Camden County was 9.9% in 2025, the data show.
reason: 2025 county table not reachable; ACS 2024 1-year county was 11.6% and warehouse SAIPE 2024 was 11.4%, so a fall to 9.9% is plausible but unconfirmed.
sql: SELECT year, all_ages_poverty_rate FROM census.saipe_poverty WHERE state='34' AND county_fips='34007' ORDER BY year

assertion: The data, which reported Camden's poverty rate was above 40% multiple times during the 2010s, show a return on the long-term investments made in the community.
reason: No city 1-year values for the 2010s were retrievable; searches found only 28.5%, 30.2% and 33.9% figures. The warehouse has no place-level ACS.
searched: Camden NJ poverty rate 2010 2015 2019 percent 40% city ACS history

assertion: Median household income for Camden residents has risen only 8% since 2010, adjusted for inflation, on par with Camden County but well below the 14% increase nationwide.
reason: No city data in the warehouse. County median rose from 60,976 (2010) to 88,755 (2024) nominal, roughly 10% real; national 2025 median is 84,780, consistent with about 14% real but the 2010 national row is absent.
sql: SELECT year, median_household_income FROM census.acs_income WHERE state='34' AND county='007' ORDER BY year
